Therefore opening_reserves and prior_year_development are returned as null. No claims development triangle was confidently readable. If higher-resolution or properly oriented pages are provided (especially the Technical Provisions / Notes to the Accounts pages and the Statement of Financial Position), a full extraction can be performed.
